name: Indian National Astronomy Olympiad
desc: The Indian National Astronomy Olympiad (INAO) is conducted by the Homi Bhabha Centre for Science Education (HBCSE) as part of the national science olympiad program. INAO serves as the primary selection mechanism for India's team to the International Olympiad on Astronomy and Astrophysics (IOAA). The competition tests theoretical knowledge, observational skills, and problem-solving abilities in astronomy and astrophysics. Top performers from INAO proceed to orientation camps and further selection rounds for international representation.
summary: National astronomy olympiad for students in India, pathway to IOAA selection.

name: Online Astronomy Competition
desc: The Online Astronomy Competition (OAC) is an international astronomy competition that tests students' knowledge in observational and theoretical astronomy. The competition consists of two main divisions: Open and Invitational. The Open division is accessible to all students worldwide, while the Invitational division is for top performers and features more challenging problems. OAC emphasizes practical astronomy skills including data analysis, celestial mechanics, and astrophysics.
summary: International online astronomy competition testing observational and theoretical knowledge.

name: USA Astronomy and Astrophysics Olympiad
desc: The USA Astronomy and Astrophysics Olympiad (USAAAO) is a national competition for high school students in the United States of America. The competition consists of multiple rounds, including a First Round and the National Astronomy Championship (NAC). Top performers from USAAAO are invited to represent the United States at the International Olympiad on Astronomy and Astrophysics (IOAA). The competition tests knowledge and problem-solving skills in astronomy, astrophysics, and related fields.
summary: National astronomy and astrophysics competition for high school students in the United States of America.
